recipe.name: Ilex / investment / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 006, native stock, lost wax: sprue from the palm. After the cast: cut the vein strokes, drill each garnet seat on its raised mark, cut it to the measured stone and burnish flush. Polish the leaves, the halos round them and the palm; leave the table's stipple and the flanks' grain as cast.
